cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
what_is_included:
Watch the sunset over the ocean and capture breathtaking views of San Diego’s Skyline in full sunset color. Captain Required.

This vessel requires a captain. We will introduce you to a local USCG licensed captain. Captains who are familiar with this vessel will be hired by the renter and paid directly, in cash in the amount of $50 per hour.
what_to_bring: Photo ID for all drivers and credit card used for payment required for check in.
